---
title: "jira.edcpptp"
description: "Daily snapshot of every EDCPPTP Jira issue, one row per issue per snapshot."
---

Daily snapshot of all issues on the EDCP - Partner Transition Project
(EDCPPTP) Jira board, which tracks partners as they onboard or transition to
CanadaLogin.

One row per Jira issue per snapshot. Each run writes a full snapshot of every
issue in the project to a new `date=` partition. Previous partitions are kept,
enabling point-in-time analysis. Comments are in
[`edcpptp_comment`](edcpptp_comment.qmd), which joins to this table on `key` and
`date`. The names and types of the custom fields in `custom_fields_json` are in
[`edcpptp_field_catalog`](edcpptp_field_catalog.qmd).

The board has three levels:

* **Epic**: a department or agency, or a major initiative.
* **Application**, **Task** or **Story**: one piece of work under an Epic.
* **Subtask**: a step under an Application or Task.

**Jira source:** `jtickets.atlassian.net`, project `EDCPPTP`, fetched via
`POST /rest/api/3/search/jql`. See the
[pipeline wiki](https://github.com/cds-snc/canadalogin-reporting-data-pipeline/wiki/Pipeline-EDCPPTP-Jira)
for details.

`Keywords`: jira, edcpptp, partner transition, PTT, onboarding, applications, departments, go-live, epics

## Provenance

Queried from Jira Cloud via API by the `edcpptp-sync` Lambda function. The
Lambda requests only the fields on a reviewed allow-list. Fields that identify
individual public servants (assignee, reporter, creator, request participants,
team) are never fetched.

* **Updated**: Daily, at ~06:15 ET
* **Retention**: Pending. To be set at a retention meeting.
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca) (Data and Research team)
* **Location**: `s3://canadalogin-reporting-transformed/edcpptp/issues/`

## Fields

One row per Jira issue per snapshot (`date` partition). A row is unique on
(`key`, `date`).

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| date | string | Partition key: the UTC date the Lambda ran (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| key | string | Jira issue key, e.g. `EDCPPTP-770`. |
| issue_type | string | Jira issue type, one of `Epic`, `Application`, `Task`, `Story`, `Subtask`. |
| summary | string | One-line issue title. |
| description | string | Full issue description, extracted from Atlassian Document Format (ADF) to plain text. |
| status | string | Board status, one of `Not started`, `Prospect`, `Paused`, `In Progress`, `Blocked by us`, `Blocked by partner`, `Done`. |
| status_category | string | Jira status category, one of `To Do` (`Not started`, `Prospect`, `Paused`), `In Progress` (`In Progress`, `Blocked by us`, `Blocked by partner`) or `Done` (`Done`). |
| status_changed | string | ISO 8601 timestamp when the issue's status category last changed. |
| priority | string | Jira priority. Unused. |
| parent_key | string | Key of the direct parent issue. An Application, Task or Story's parent is an Epic. |
| parent_type | string | Issue type of the direct parent. Null for Epics. |
| parent_summary | string | Summary of the direct parent. Null for Epics. |
| epic_key | string | Key of the Epic at the top of the issue's hierarchy. An Epic's own key for Epics. |
| epic_summary | string | Summary of that Epic: the department, agency or initiative name. |
| subtask_count | integer | Number of direct child Subtasks. |
| issue_links_json | string | JSON array of linked issues. |
| resolution | string | Jira resolution, `Done` once resolved. Null if unresolved. |
| resolution_date | string | ISO 8601 timestamp when the issue was resolved. Null if unresolved. |
| created | string | ISO 8601 timestamp when the issue was created. |
| updated | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent field or comment update. |
| due_date | string | Jira due date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Rarely filled in. |
| start_date | string | Jira start date (`YYYY-MM-DD`), from custom field `customfield_12614`. Rarely filled in. |
| labels | string | Semicolon-separated list of labels applied to the issue. Empty string if none. |
| comment_count | integer | Total number of comments on the issue. Equals the issue's row count in [`edcpptp_comment`](edcpptp_comment.qmd) for the same `date`. |
| attachment_count | integer | Number of attachments on the issue. |
| custom_fields_json | string | JSON object of the issue's allow-listed custom fields, keyed by Jira field ID. Only fields with a value are present. `{}` for every issue type except `Application`. See [Custom fields](#custom-fields). |
| fetched_at | string | UTC timestamp when the Lambda wrote this row (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`). |

### Custom fields

`custom_fields_json` holds the 34 Application fields on the allow-list in the
pipeline repo (`infra/modules/edcpptp/lambda_src/allowed_fields.json`). The
names below are the Jira display names. Many are often empty.

Each value keeps its Jira type:

* **text**: a JSON string.
* **option**: a JSON string holding the chosen option.
* **multi-option**: a JSON array of strings, one per checked box.
* **number**: a JSON number, e.g. `510000.0`.
* **date**: a JSON string, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

## Notes

All timestamp columns (`created`, `updated`, `status_changed`,
`resolution_date`, `fetched_at`) are stored as `string`. The ISO 8601 ones carry
an offset from UTC, e.g. `2026-11-10T14:27:11.967-0500`.

**Every snapshot repeats every issue.** Each partition holds the whole project. Filter 
to one `date` before counting. For the latest snapshot:

```sql
WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM "jira"."edcpptp$partitions")
```

**Department: Epic or field.** `epic_summary` is the Epic the Application sits
under. `customfield_13494` (Department or Agency) is what the partner entered.
They usually agree, but not always. Group by `epic_summary` to match the
board.

**Overlapping volume fields.** There are two sets of similar user estimates:
`customfield_13487` to `customfield_13489`, and `customfield_13581` to
`customfield_13583`. The second set is filled in more often, and Applications
with the first set usually have the second too. Prefer the second set.
